note: Written from gummiband_app::OPTIONS and gummiband_app::Preset. Do not edit, write it again: cargo run -p gummiband-app --example plugin_table > plugin/gb_plugin/route_options.json

choices.help: No copper stays: every track and via goes, locked ones too, and the board is laid anew.
Locked tracks and vias stay as fixed copper that the router connects to, all unlocked copper goes and is laid anew: for a board on which the copper that must stay is locked.

All copper stays, locked or not, and only what is still open is laid, with nets only the open connections of those nets: for "I laid these nets by hand, finish the rest" and for a track that was started.
Needs nets: the unlocked copper of those nets is taken out and they are laid anew, everything else stays: for "lay net X again".

options.help: What of the copper on the board stays, and what is laid.
options.name: scope

options.help: Lay only these nets: with scope finish and reroute the others stay as they are, with fresh and keep_locked they stay unrouted.
options.name: nets

options.default: on with scope reroute and with scope finish and nets, else off
options.help: Single nets on kept copper: the unlocked tracks of the other nets shift aside to let a connection pass.
options.name: shove

options.default: 8 with scope reroute and with scope finish and nets, else 0
options.help: Single nets on kept copper: radius in mm within which the unlocked tracks of other nets give way and are routed again when a connection finds no way.
options.name: give

options.default: on with scope fresh and keep_locked, off with finish and reroute
options.help: Let parts next to clearance problems and open connections shift a little while the copper follows.
options.name: move_parts

options.help: References that never move under move_parts, placements and clear_corridors.
options.name: fixed

options.help: Copper layers treated as planes besides those of KiCad type "power": not routed, their zones stay.
options.name: plane_layers

choices.help: Such a net is laid as tracks like any net, and the area is not looked at.

Such a net is not laid as tracks: the fill connects it, only what the fill does not reach gets copper of its own, the report says which pads stay open, and where the route leaves a connection open the board is routed a second time as with tracks and the better of the two is the result.

options.help: How nets with an area (a zone of the file or a pour of pour) on a routed layer are connected.
options.name: areas

options.help: With areas fill: nets that get a pour after the route, each NET or NET:LAYER,LAYER (the outer layers where none is given), which the route takes as an area of the net.
options.name: pour

options.help: With areas fill: an island of fill that holds pads gets one via where it joins the area, set on the finished copper where the fill model finds the spot.
options.name: area_stitch

choices.help: runs 4, generations 1, geometry_generations 0, open_end_seconds 0: the quickest look at whether the board routes and where it is tight, as the benchmark suite routes; leaves many clearance violations.

runs 14, generations 3, geometry_generations 0, open_end_seconds 0: the whole order search without the rounds that select by the clearance check, in about a third of the time of standard and with many more clearance violations: for a first result on a real board.
runs 14, generations 3, geometry_generations 3, open_end_seconds 0: the defaults, a usable board in a few minutes.

runs 14, generations 3, geometry_generations 3, open_end_seconds 600: standard, then the open end improves the result for 10 minutes (fewer vias, fewer violations, sometimes the last connections), for the last run of a board and not with pairs band.

options.help: How much search the route gets: a preset sets runs, generations, geometry_generations and open_end_seconds, and each of the four wins over it when given.
options.name: preset

options.default: what the preset says: 14 with standard
options.help: Portfolio size: router runs with different orders in every generation.
options.name: runs

options.help: Via site grid pitch in mm.
options.name: via_pitch

options.help: Via cost in mm of track.
options.name: via_cost

options.help: Weight of the preferred layer directions in every third run (0: off).
options.name: layer_dirs

options.help: Hints from local patterns of the board, comma separated: shares, decaps, rows, pairs, groups, groups-short, all or none.
options.name: patterns

options.help: Factor on the via cost in the pass that routes connections with vias again and keeps what has fewer vias (0: off).
options.name: via_pass

choices.help: Each net on its own, like any other net.

Two nets, the second pulled to the way of the first with the weight pair_pull, and the finished tracks close up to the pair gap where nothing lies between: for every pair recognised by name, the gentle way on a board that is not dense.

Experimental: one wide track per pair that is split into two parallel tracks, for the pairs that a diff_pair_gap rule or a net class of their own marks (pair_all: every pair), which keeps them coupled, costs connections on a dense board and does not work with an open end.

options.help: How the two nets of a differential pair are laid.
options.name: pairs

options.default: 1 with pairs pull, 0 with pairs band
options.help: With pairs pull: weight of the pull between the two nets (1 is a good start, up to about 4); with pairs band: the same pull for the pairs that get no wide track.
options.name: pair_pull

options.help: With pairs band: length difference left within a pair in mm.
options.name: pair_skew

options.default: none: the widths of the net classes and rules
options.help: With pairs band: target differential impedance in ohm, which sets the track width per layer from the stackup.
options.name: pair_zdiff

options.help: With pairs band: a wide track for every pair recognised by name, not only those a rule or a net class of their own marks.
options.name: pair_all

options.help: Experimental, with pairs band: the wide track ends just outside the pads and two single tracks connect them.
options.name: breakouts

options.help: Experimental, with pairs band: two vias side by side are one via pair that turns with the wide track.
options.name: via_pairs

options.help: Rounds of negotiated routing from the start, in a second search next to the plain one (0: only when the plain search leaves a few connections open).
options.name: negotiate

options.default: what the preset says: 3 with standard
options.help: Generations of the evolutionary order search after the portfolio.
options.name: generations

options.default: what the preset says: 3 with standard
options.help: Generations that select by clearance violations after the geometry step (0: fastest, many more violations).
options.name: geometry_generations

options.help: Seed of the search: the same seed gives the same result, another one a different try.
options.name: seed

options.help: Folder for one SVG of the best candidate per generation, with an animation if ImageMagick is there.
options.name: frames

options.default: what the preset says: 0 with standard
options.help: Open end with a time budget: after the normal search keep improving for this many seconds, then finish the best result (0: off).
options.name: open_end_seconds

options.help: In the open end: what a via is worth in mm of track when its results are judged.
options.name: open_via_cost

options.default: 0.03 in an open ended run, but 0 with scope reroute and with scope finish and nets, else 0
options.help: Reserve in mm on top of the clearances that the finished copper gets where there is room.
options.name: air

options.help: Width in mm that tracks of the default net class grow to at the end where there is room (0: off).
options.name: prefer_width

choices.help: Any-angle tracks with arcs, as the rubber bands lie.
Conventional 45 degree routing as a last step, which never adds a clearance violation.

options.help: Track angles of the result.
options.name: angles

options.help: Meanders for the length and skew rules of the .kicad_dru.
options.name: tune

options.help: Highest meander bump in mm.
options.name: tune_amplitude

options.help: Air between neighbouring meander legs in track widths.
options.name: tune_spacing

options.help: Try this many placements from the netlist, route each and go on with the best (0: the placement stays).
options.name: placements

options.help: First seed of placements, and the seed of clear_corridors.
options.name: placement_seed

options.help: Experimental: before routing, parts in the band of a group of tracks between two parts get new positions.
options.name: clear_corridors

options.help: JSON file with options per net: a track width in mm, or an object with width, min_width, neck_refs, priority and skip.
options.name: net_widths

options.help: JSON file with a routing priority per net, lower routes first.
options.name: net_priorities

options.help: Switch on KiCad's teardrops in the written board and its project.
options.name: teardrops
